corrections.why: The 1938 survey description names the tower as a U.S. Forest Service tower. 'National Forest' is a generic heading that does not name the agency.

notes_for_editor: Only one page was read: the Forest Lookouts page, which quotes a 1938 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description and carries a 'Removed' status line. No build date, staffing, fire, access or removal date was found in the sources read, so the story leaves them out. The survey designation 'Higdon Fire Tower' and the description that places the station 0.3 mile from a 50-foot tower may refer to different structures; not resolved. A search snippet for a Natural Atlas listing calls Higdon a tower in Mark Twain National Forest; that page was not read and the agency is not confirmed beyond the 'U.S. Forest Service' survey wording. No photos found. Budget used: 2 searches, 2 page reads. Fact-check 2026-10-21: every claim matched the survey text; story wording reworded where it copied the survey, and the county line added to evidence.
